notes.title: Necrobarb Side Adventure is Released !!!
notes.notes:
This is a game changer for those of you looking to smash through those bosses.

Enjoy a new addition to the town, the watchtower.  

We all here at Silent Daddio Studios hope that you enjoy playing this side adventure as much as we enjoyed making it.

notes.title: Necrobarb Side Adventure Release Date Announced
notes.notes:
There is a problem at the WatchTower.  Something scary is going on.   

Adventure into the Watch Tower, and confront the Commander of the Watch.

Planned to be released on April 1st, 2019.

notes.title: New Adventure Added, Under Ms. Katz House
notes.notes:
The latest release has been updated.  Now there is a new in town adventure, Under Ms. Katz House.  Strange things are going on under Ms. Katz house.  Better go talk to Ms. Katz and see if there is anything you can do to help out.

Also, in this update, bug fixes for flow of abyss over the world.  

Good luck and keep gaming.
